newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end mixed in stagnant trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end mixed in stagnant trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's foreign currency B share index closed minimally higher in sluggish trade on Thursday, with investors moving to the sidelines in light of the market's recent bearish performance, brokers said.
The index inched up 0.01 points to end at 146.63 on turnover of HK$42 million against Wednesday's HK$40 million.

The domestic A share index slipped 6.69 points or 1.56 percent to 421.60 due in part to profit-taking in giant newcomer First Automobile Works Car Co Ltd 0080.SZ and caution over A share leader Shenzhen Development Bank which will resume trading on Friday after a five-session halt, they said.
